title: Skip push computation when there are no subscribers
description:
`gopush` (`go/state.go:202`) marshals, unmarshals and diffs the entire state before it ever looks at `s.conns`. With zero connected clients the whole cycle runs and the result is thrown away.

## Fix

Guard the expensive body on `NumConnections() == 0`.

The catch: `s.data.bytes` and `patcher.prev` then go stale, and `State.Handle` (`state.go:116`) subscribes and immediately calls `conn.Push()`, which would ship that stale snapshot. So the guard needs a paired "recompute before the first subscriber's initial push" — either mark the cache dirty and force a synchronous compute in `Handle` before `conn.Push()`, or run one full `gopush` on the 0→1 connection transition.

Add a test that asserts a client connecting after a quiet period receives current state, not the snapshot from when the last client left.

## Impact

For rais-main this is idle-cost elimination: with no browser open, the process currently still burns ~3.7 cycles/sec x ~11 ms plus ~10 MB/s of garbage producing deltas nobody receives.
